title: Finite constructible stratifications with a local property glue over a qcqs base
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and suppose there is a finite affine open covering $X=\bigcup_aW_a$ such that, for every $a$, a finite partition $W_a=\coprod_bW_{a,b}$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] has each base change $U\times_XW_{a,b}\to W_{a,b}$ finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Then $X$ has a finite partition $X=\coprod_iX_i$ by constructible locally closed subschemes such that every base change $U\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is finite etale. All fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, second paragraph, line 12045 ('In general, we may assume X is affine'); the finite-intersection/disjointization construction is deferred to the split of this node

mathlib_searches.query: glue finite constructible locally closed stratifications from a finite affine open cover of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has finite affine-cover and constructible-set ingredients, but no theorem assembling local constructible stratifications with an arbitrary stable property.
Finite affine refinements of compact covers are available; no constructible-stratification locality/gluing statement appears.
Only constructible subsets, affine-cover refinements, and topology operations; no locality theorem for finite constructible stratifications.
